justification: A reliability tier is only claimable if its Wilson 95% lower bound can plausibly support it. At perfect observed precision the lower bound is 0.9634 at n=100, 0.9817 at n=200 and 0.9874 at n=300. Below n=200 a 0.99 claim cannot be evidenced even by a flawless run, so 200 is the floor for any tier claim; Wilson lower bound is reported for every tier regardless.
rejectionPrecedent: Stage 3D produced three rules at precision 1.0000 with n=1-2 (Wilson LB 0.21-0.34); those were rejected and the same floor applies here.
